'''Boss Mansion''', informally known as '''King Ozz's Palace''' or '''Ozz's Palace''', was the residence of [[King/Legends|King]] [[Ozz (Ugnaught)/Legends|Ozz]]. It was located in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Ugnorgrad/Legends|Ugnorgrad]] on the [[Ugnaught Surface/Legends|Ugnaught Surface]].<ref name="ActionTidings2" />
